summary: Oneida County, WI 100-ft Aermotor tower built 1936; sold and taken down in June 2017; the planned re-erection in New Richmond is not confirmed; the site is listed as gone.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor tower with a US Forest Service-style stairway
facts.status_note: Sold by the DNR and taken down over two days in June 2017. The Wisconsin list marks the site as gone. The 2017 article says the family planned to re-erect it in New Richmond; no source read confirms that it was done.

events.note: NHLR and the 2017 article both give 1936.
Sold right after DNR decommissioning and taken down over two days; the article is dated June 13, 2017. The buyers planned to re-erect it in New Richmond, WI.
Registered June 9, 2017 (US 1196, WI 8). The registration predates the June 2017 removal described in the article.

notes_for_editor: Build year 1936 and the 2017 removal are well supported. The New Richmond re-erection rests on a 2017 plan only; no later source was read, so the story says the work is not confirmed. The status is 'removed' because the tower left the site; the Wisconsin list says gone. The NHLR registration (June 9, 2017) predates the June 2017 removal in the article, which fits the brief's note about registrations. No staffing or access source was found.
